chapter: Dizzy, Chano Pozo and Afro-Cuban jazz
title: Why he did not like Gillespie's big band
summary: He says the music was too advanced for the available musicians.

blocks.x: What about -- so for your money the Gillespie big band, was that -- what's your feeling about it?

There was -- I tell you why I didn't like the band. Maybe I didn't hear enough of the band. I just had the band. But even when Chano was there, to me this was not jazz, and the music was (inaudible) for the band. The music was too advanced (inaudible) for the material he have to work with.
To create a band in such a new style means (inaudible) require a higher musicians (inaudible) and then guy with a mentality to be able to absorb what they -- in other words, they change too abruptly.
